Synopsis:
Fed Governor Waller signaled a preference to hold rates steady, sparking a stock rally and yield decline, though he left the door open to a hike if inflation re-accelerates. The upcoming August CPI print has become the pivotal data point determining the Fed's next move — a near coin-flip between hold and hike. Nvidia made a $13B acquisition of Hugging Face, extending its AI ecosystem reach amid concerns of circular financing. The Japanese yen surged 2% on BOJ rate hike expectations, with markets pricing ~50bps of BOJ tightening by April, though Japan's fiscal trajectory remains a wildcard.
